about: MANZZA Industry Pvt. Ltd. is an Indian manufacturer specializing in electrical steel laminations used in transformer core construction. Based in Bengaluru, Karnataka, MANZZA serves transformer manufacturers across Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh, Telangana and Tamil Nadu, with the capability to serve a broader customer base as the business grows. Our focus is on precision-cut electrical steel laminations, consistent manufacturing, customer-specific specifications and dependable B2B supply. We manufacture different types of transformer laminations to support a range of transformer designs, from conventional E&I constructions to advanced mitre-core assemblies using step-lap construction. MANZZA works with both standard and customized requirements, helping transformer manufacturers source laminations suited to their engineering drawings, core designs and production requirements.
